title: system.usage.module Output
description: Output schema for the system.usage.module module (PROTOCOL_SPEC 6.7.1). Every statistic below is computed over the requested `period` window, never over the full retained history; the sole exception is the fixed 24-entry span of hourly_distribution, whose per-bucket counts are still period-filtered (6.7.1.2).

module_id.description: Canonical ID of the module this report covers, echoed from the input.

period.description: The requested time window, echoed back. Matches ^[1-9][0-9]*[hd]$ (PROTOCOL_SPEC 6.7.1.1).

call_count.description: Calls to this module within the period.

error_count.description: Failed calls to this module within the period.

avg_latency_ms.description: Mean latency in milliseconds across the calls in the period. 0 when there are no calls.

p99_latency_ms.description: Nearest-rank 99th percentile latency in milliseconds over the period: sorted[min(ceil(0.99 * N), N) - 1], with 0 when there are no samples. No interpolation (PROTOCOL_SPEC 6.7.1.3).

trend.description: Direction of change against the immediately preceding window of equal length, per the normative table in PROTOCOL_SPEC 6.7.1.5.

callers.description: Per-caller breakdown of the calls in the period.

items.description: Usage statistics for one caller of this module over the period.

caller_id.description: Caller identity. A call recorded with no caller identity is attributed to the literal string 'unknown' — never null, never omitted, and never the ACL token '@external' (PROTOCOL_SPEC 6.7.1.4).

call_count.description: Calls from this caller within the period.

error_count.description: Failed calls from this caller within the period.

avg_latency_ms.description: Mean latency in milliseconds for this caller's calls in the period.

hourly_distribution.description: The 24 hourly buckets ending at the current hour (now-23h .. now), zero-filled across gaps and sorted ascending by hour. The 24-entry span is fixed and is NOT widened or narrowed by `period` (PROTOCOL_SPEC 6.7.1.2).

hour.description: UTC hourly bucket key in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH, e.g. 2026-03-08T14. This is the key UsageCollector produces; a module layer MUST NOT reformat it (PROTOCOL_SPEC 6.7.1.2).

call_count.description: Calls recorded in this hourly bucket, filtered by the requested period.

error_count.description: Failed calls recorded in this hourly bucket, filtered by the requested period.
